idea: A waitress in a late-night diner meets a stranger who knows her name.

panels.prompt: Full-color cinematic film still, wide establishing shot, low angle looking up through the diner's front window into its interior. Neon “OPEN” sign glows above the door; rain streaks down glass. Lena stands behind the counter, wiping it with a rag, eyes scanning the room nervously. Jasper sits alone on a stool near the far end, head tilted slightly as he stares out the window. Diner Counter occupies center frame, lights from inside cast amber glow onto wet pavement outside. Jasper is a man, late 30s to early 40s, tall, with salt-and-pepper stubble, wearing a worn leather jacket over a gray hoodie. He’s calm but observant, carrying an old vinyl record case under his arm.Diner. Counter is the interior of a dimly lit, retro-style diner at night — neon signs flicker, stools are empty except for one, the counter is cluttered with half-eaten food trays and coffee cups.
panels.intent: Establish the setting and tension — Lena’s routine life collides with Jasper’s quiet presence who knows her name without speaking yet.

panels.prompt: Medium shot, eye-level, focused tightly on Lena’s face as she turns slowly toward the entrance. Her expression shifts from wary to curious. Behind her, the counter remains blurred. Jasper leans forward slightly, fingers tapping rhythmically against his thigh. His gaze follows hers. Diner Counter frames left side of panel. Jasper is a man, late 30s to early 40s, tall, with salt-and-pepper stubble, wearing a worn leather jacket over a gray hoodie. He’s calm but observant, carrying an old vinyl record case under his arm.Diner. Counter is the interior of a dimly lit, retro-style diner at night — neon signs flicker, stools are empty except for one, the counter is cluttered with half-eaten food trays and coffee cups.
panels.intent: Show their mutual awareness — Lena notices him first, then hesitates before approaching, while Jasper watches silently, waiting for something to happen.

panels.prompt: Close-up, centered on Jasper’s hands holding the vinyl case open like a book, revealing a cracked cover that reads "Soulful Echoes." He doesn’t look up when Lena approaches. Light reflects off the edge of the case. Lena steps closer, voice barely audible, saying nothing. Jasper is a man, late 30s to early 40s, tall, with salt-and-pepper stubble, wearing a worn leather jacket over a gray hoodie. He’s calm but observant, carrying an old vinyl record case under his arm.Diner.
panels.intent: Reveal hidden detail — not just visual connection, but emotional weight — this stranger holds music that might connect them beyond words or context.

panels.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from Lena’s perspective, framing only Jasper’s shoulder and hand resting lightly on the table beside him. In background blur, we see the menu board glowing faintly. Lena reaches across the counter to place a small white napkin box next to his plate. No sound. Only movement. Jasper is a man, late 30s to early 40s, tall, with salt-and-pepper stubble, wearing a worn leather jacket over a gray hoodie. He’s calm but observant, carrying an old vinyl record case under his arm.Diner. Counter is the interior of a dimly lit, retro-style diner at night — neon signs flicker, stools are empty except for one, the counter is cluttered with half-eaten food trays and coffee cups.
panels.intent: Create intimacy through gesture — offering comfort without needing to speak, signaling trust begins even if unspoken.

panels.prompt: Tight close-up on Lena’s mouth opening slightly as she whispers, “You know my name.” Jasper looks directly at her now, eyes softening. Their faces fill almost entire screen. Background fades into darkness. Jasper is a man, late 30s to early 40s, tall, with salt-and-pepper stubble, wearing a worn leather jacket over a gray hoodie. He’s calm but observant, carrying an old vinyl record case under his arm.Diner.
panels.intent: Deliver the pivotal moment — recognition confirmed by silence, warmth blooming between two strangers bound by shared knowledge.

panels.prompt: Slow zoom-out to medium-wide shot showing both standing together at the counter, no longer separated. Lena smiles shyly, Jasper nods once gently. Outside, streetlights blink past windows. They don't touch — they simply exist in each other’s space. He’s calm but observant, carrying an old vinyl record case under his arm.Diner. panels.intent: End quietly — not resolution, but beginning — where curiosity becomes companionship, memory becoming future.
